1. [Maximum mark: 6]
Bob measured the heights of 63 students. After analysis, he conjectured that the
height, H , of the students could be modelled by a normal distribution with mean
166.5 cm and standard deviation 5 cm.
(a) Based on this assumption, estimate the number of these students whose height is
at least 170 cm. [3 marks]

started at the 5 cm mark and not at the zero mark.
(b) What are the correct values of the mean and variance of the distribution of the
heights of these students? [3 marks]
